description: Public calculator (NO token needed): compute piecewise Wathan e1RM, bodyweight/sex/age-adjusted strength score, tier (untrained -> elite), and kg needed for the next tier from one set.

bodyweight_kg.description: Athlete bodyweight in kg (added into total system load for dip, pull_up, chin_up; pulled automatically when signed in to STRUGGL).

weight_kg.description: Load lifted in kg (ADDED load for dip, pull_up, chin_up).
